Rewrite is STILL on. We appreciate your support and patience.

Patch notes: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/take-and-hold-update-14/3317351

Welcome to Take and Hold, a KoTH cooperation-based game where players compete on two teams alongside AI. Choose between 10 different Classes and harness their abilities in order to succeed on the battlefield. You can play this game by yourself, with friends, or in a full server! Private servers are free as well, so have fun.

Featuring:
- Large scale PvPvE battles
- Boss battles
- 10 playable classes
- Mobile compatibility
- Free Private Servers + commands

Everything in this game is being remade from the ground up. Do not consider this version the final product.

If you enjoy the game, donations are very much appreciated. If you cannot donate, send us your best wishes and cheer us on!
